clues.it: Anna era nella 13ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Olga.
clues.en: Anna was in the 13th column, in the 1st row and in the same room as Olga.

clues.it: Olga era nella 15ª colonna, nella 2ª riga e a nord di Fabio.
clues.en: Olga was in the 15th column, in the 2nd row and north of Fabio.

clues.it: Ugo era nella stessa stanza di Sergio.
clues.en: Ugo was in the same room as Sergio.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 11ª colonna, accanto a un'ancora e a nord di Tea.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 11th column, beside an anchor and north of Tea.

clues.it: Nino era nella 4ª colonna, in una stanza diversa da Anna e sul Ponte.
clues.en: Nino was in the 4th column, in a different room from Anna and on the Deck.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Irene era nella 5ª colonna, nella 7ª riga e da sola nel Faro.
clues.en: Irene was in the 5th column, in the 7th row and alone in the Lighthouse.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 16ª colonna, nella 8ª riga e a nord di Luca.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 16th column, in the 8th row and north of Luca.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a una lanterna, a ovest di Marta e da solo sul Molo.
clues.en: Dario was beside a lantern, west of Marta and alone on the Dock.

clues.it: Vito era l'unica persona su una rete e in una stanza diversa da Irene.
clues.en: Vito was the only person on a net and in a different room from Irene.

clues.it: Rosa era in una stanza diversa da Marta e in Plancia.
clues.en: Rosa was in a different room from Marta and on the Bridge.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 6ª colonna, nella 12ª riga e a ovest di Tea.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 6th column, in the 12th row and west of Tea.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a un barile e in una stanza diversa da Olga.
clues.en: Elena was beside a barrel and in a different room from Olga.

clues.it: Tea era nella 14ª colonna, accanto a una corda e in una stanza diversa da Luca.
clues.en: Tea was in the 14th column, beside a rope coil and in a different room from Luca.

clues.it: Luca era seduto su una sedia e accanto a un timone, ma non era accanto a un salvagente.
clues.en: Luca was sitting on a chair and beside a helm, but was not beside a life ring.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a una pianta, a ovest di Anna e sulla Spiaggia.
clues.en: Marta was beside a plant, west of Anna and on the Beach.

general_clues.en: 8 in the west half of the grid.
8 in the north half of the grid.
